tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List every category, page section, visual style, tech stack and display font in the BestSaaSWebDesigns catalog of real SaaS marketing websites, with how many sites match each and a link to the gallery page for it. Call this first to learn valid filter values for search_sites.

tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: Find real SaaS marketing websites to use as design references. Filter by category, page section (e.g. sites with a captured pricing page), visual style, tech stack, font or brand colour, and/or a free-text query (product name or industry). Returns each site's website URL, category, style, stack, col

tools.name: list_site_links
tools.description: List real SaaS marketing websites as plain links: name and homepage URL only. Same filters as search_sites, up to 50 at a time. Use it when you want a batch of live sites to open and study yourself in a browser; this server never fetches them. Use search_sites or get_site for palettes, fonts, stacks

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Get one SaaS website from the catalog by slug (from search_sites): website URL, category, style, stack, colour palette, fonts, captured sections, a link to its screenshots, and links to similar sites by category, style, stack and section.
